title: Meta-Integrity: A System That Verifies Itself
summary: The message proves itself. The system validates its own communication. Integrity is demonstrated, not claimed.
body:
Today we published our first official verifiable communication.

W-COMM-001 is fully live.

This communication is cryptographically verifiable by the very system it describes.

That means:

- The message proves itself
- The system validates its own communication
- Integrity is demonstrated, not claimed

This is meta-integrity.

A system that does not ask for trust but allows anyone to verify the truth independently.
